bloompets.skill.awareness.desc: Steps out of fire, lava and cacti, back to your side. No fall damage.
bloompets.skill.gore.desc: A %s%% chance a hit does double damage (half its level in %%, up to 50%% at 100).
bloompets.skill.fast_food.desc: A 50%% chance to heal by the damage it deals.
bloompets.skill.thick_fur.desc: Takes half damage from attacks and arrows, and shakes off burning.
bloompets.skill.holy_hound.desc: Magic, poison and wither heal it instead of hurting it.
bloompets.skill.shock_proof.desc: Takes a sixth of the damage from explosions and lightning.
bloompets.skill.max.desc: A gold name and a sparkle. Once each time it comes out (called, or joining your party), a blow that would make it faint gives it a second wind instead: back to half health.
bloompets.skill.wolf.first.desc: When you and it hit the same enemy within 3 seconds, its bite deals 20%% more.
bloompets.skill.wolf.awareness.desc: It smells danger: steps out of fire, lava and cacti back to you, and lands soft (no fall damage).
bloompets.skill.wolf.gore.desc: A %s%% chance its bite tears deep: double damage, and the target Bleeds (half its level in %%, up to 50%% at 100).
bloompets.skill.wolf.special.desc: In a fight, every 30 seconds it howls: you and your pets nearby get Strength I for 6 seconds, and enemies near it are slowed.
bloompets.skill.wolf.fast_food.desc: A 50%% chance its bites mend it by the damage they deal.
bloompets.skill.wolf.thick_fur.desc: Half damage from blows and arrows; fire goes out on it fast.
bloompets.skill.wolf.holy_hound.desc: Poison, wither and magic mend it instead of hurting it.
bloompets.skill.wolf.shock_proof.desc: Explosions and lightning barely scratch it (a sixth of the damage).
bloompets.skill.iron_golem.first.desc: A walking fortress: +%s health while it's in your party (half a point a level).
bloompets.skill.iron_golem.special.desc: Once a day, while it follows you, a blow that would kill you leaves you at half a heart with Resistance II for 20 seconds. A totem in your hand goes first.
bloompets.skill.iron_golem.thick_fur.des: Takes half damage from attacks, arrows and fire, and shakes off burning.
bloompets.skill.polar_bear.first.desc: Can't be knocked back, slowed or frozen.
bloompets.skill.polar_bear.special.desc: Its hits slow (%s) and weaken (%s) for 5 seconds (Slowness IV and Weakness II from level 50).
bloompets.skill.goat.special.desc: Its third hit also launches the target high into the air.
bloompets.skill.panda.first.desc: When it wins a fight, it and you get Regeneration I for 8 seconds.
bloompets.skill.panda.special.desc: A %s%% chance on each hit to heal it, you and friends within 6 blocks for %s health, and hurt the undead nearby.
